result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP claims, Vendor legal violations, Vendor-caused unauthorized access or disclosure, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; Customer’s indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and legal violations; and standard notice, control, cooperation, and settlement procedures are included. The added IP remedies appropriately cure the existing Section 9.3 cross-reference without altering that termination right. Drafting is professional, with only minor room to clarify that settlement consent may not be unreasonably withheld and to define Vendor-caused data breaches more comprehensively than unauthorized access or disclosure.
